description: Given an issue id (from projscan_doctor / projscan_analyze) OR a file + rule pair, return a structured action prompt: headline, why it matters, where to change, one-paragraph instruction the agent can execute, optional suggested test. Rule-driven; no LLM inside projscan. Use this to close the diagnose -> fix loop.

file.description: File path (repo-relative). Required when no `issue_id` is given - combined with `rule` to synthesize a fix request.

issue_id.description: Issue id from a previous projscan_doctor / projscan_analyze response.

rule.description: Rule / issue-id prefix (e.g. "unused-dependency", "cycle-detected"). Required when no `issue_id` is given.

severity.description: Optional. When synthesizing via file+rule, sets the severity for the suggestion. Default: warning.

name: projscan_fix_suggest
